Good to Know

Booking & Terms

The essentials, so there are no surprises when you block your date.

01

Securing Your Date

A 50% advance payment blocks the team and your date on our calendar.

02

Balance Payment

40% is cleared on the last day of the event, and the final 10% once your album design is finalised.

03

Coverage Windows

We recommend a single 6–7 hour slot per event for complete, unhurried coverage.

04

Travel

Travel is included; accommodation is arranged separately for locations outside Hyderabad.

05

Changes in Plan

Postponements are accommodated based on our availability on the new date.

06

Advance Payments

Once a date is blocked, the advance amount is non-refundable — thank you for understanding.
